Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Safiyy usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and untainted and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Safiyy total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
